name: 中文注音鉛筆局部辨識模型（實驗）
architecture: 160 histogram gradient boosted trees, max depth 5 / 24 leaves, pixel evidence with surrounding component context

training.source: 16 source pages, grouped 11 train / 2 validation / 3 development evaluation; six genuine blank pairs plus ten old weak pairs

parameters.hardNegativeMining: up to 1600 additional retained-print pixels per training variant from components touching handwriting, weight 4

limitations: Six Chinese/Zhuyin source pages from one workbook; no general accuracy claim
Ten earlier English pairs use imperfect third-party-cleaned weak references
Sparse registered labels exclude ambiguity; source page variants remain grouped
Development evaluation pages have been inspected; no blind test claim
English workbook mode retains revision 2; this model is an optional Chinese/Zhuyin experiment
Overlapping print, circles, dotted grids and faint strokes still need manual review
PHTI FCNN unchanged; repair uses local inpainting, not trained character generation
